description.describe_ch: 介紹軟體工程基本的原則與觀念。學生修習此課後可以學習到軟體工程紀律、專案管理、需求、設計、測試、版本管理及軟體維護等基本觀念。學生可以透過操作軟體工程工具的方式學習這些概念。
description.describe_eh: Introduce the basic principles and concepts of software engineering. Upon completing this course, students will have a basic understanding of software engineering disciplines, project management, requirements, software design, testing, version control, and software maintenance. Students will learn the concept by means of software engineering tools.

targets.describe_ch: 了解軟體工程紀律於軟體開發的重要性
targets.describe_en: Understand the importance of software engineering disciplines to software development

targets.describe_ch: 了解開發軟體系統所需的工程原則與方法
targets.describe_en: Understand the underlying principles and methods on which real world applications are built

targets.describe_ch: 學習使用各種軟體工程輔助工具
targets.describe_en: Learn to use tools for software engineering

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為應始終保持專業、準備充分且有禮貌。為確保良好的學習環境，所有同學和教師應尊重彼此的尊嚴，進而促進有效的學習。
請遵守以下規則，以適應班級文化:

#### 一、課堂禮儀

1. 多元化與包容性
   課堂活動應在友好的互動氛圍中進行，尊重並欣賞每位同學的背景與觀點，包括學制、入學途徑、文化、種族、性別等多方面。

2. 課堂行為
   1. 學生需準時上課；若無法準時到達，請重新考慮選擇課程。
   2. 上課時應避免講話、閱讀其他資料、打瞌睡或從事與課程無關的活動，除非參與分組討論，應盡量減少與旁人對話。
   3. 當同學簡報或提問時，應全神貫注地聆聽。

二、課程交流及網路禮儀

1. iLearn 課堂規範
   在iLearn平台上，需遵守課堂行為規範，尊重同學及教師。
   
2. 線上參與
   1. 積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並按時完成學習任務。
   2. 在線上討論中，不應主導討論，要給予其他同學發言的機會，提升學習體驗。
      a. 保持開放的態度，尊重不同意見，並可以表達您的觀點。
      b. 適當表達想法，避免使用粗俗或不當語言。
      c. 以主題為重點，簡潔明確地表達。
      d. 在發表評論前，應先閱讀所有相關發言，以避免重複或回答已被解答的問題。
      e. 在發送評論前應進行仔細檢查。
      f. 適度使用表情符號，避免過度。
      g. 避免使用地方語或俚語，防止誤解。
      h. 分享提示時，避免取笑他人的能力。
      i. 尊重他人隱私，分享資訊前需徵得許可。
      j. 不發佈不當信息，不轉發病毒警告、連鎖信等。

三、學生責任

1. 個人資訊更新
   a. 每學期開始前，確認並更新MyFCU上的個人資料，包括手機和通訊地址，以便教師和職員能夠聯絡您。
   b. 確保逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID啟用，o365為師生溝通的主要工具。
   c. 與教師及同學交流時，務必清晰、禮貌地寫作，並署名，匿名信件不會獲得回覆。

2. 課程大綱與學習管理
   a. 詳讀課程教學大綱，了解並遵守要求，及時更新最新資訊，合理安排學習時間。
   b. 定期檢查逢甲大學電子郵件和iLearn，及時掌握課程信息。

3. 教學回饋
   a. 根據授課內容和方式，填寫期中及期末教學回饋表。期中評估表應於第4至第8週填寫，期末意見調查及學習目標達成情況調查應於學期結束前填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should be professional, well-prepared and courteous at all times. To ensure a positive learning environment, all students and teachers are expected to respect each other's dignity, which in turn promotes effective learning.
Please observe the following rules as appropriate to the classroom culture.

A) Classroom Etiquette

1. Diversity and Inclusion
   Classroom activities should be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere that respects and appreciates the backgrounds and perspectives of all students, including academic systems, pathways, cultures, races, and genders.

2. Classroom Behavior
   1. Students are expected to be on time for class; if they are unable to arrive on time, they should reconsider their choice of program. 
   2. Avoid talking, reading other materials, dozing, or engaging in non-course related activities during class, and minimize conversations with others unless participating in group discussions. 
   3. listen attentively to classmates when they are giving presentations or asking questions.

B) Course Communication and Internet Etiquette

1. iLearn Classroom Rules
   On the iLearn platform, you must abide by the rules of classroom behavior and respect your classmates and teachers.
   
2. Online Participation
   1. Actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete the learning tasks on time. 
   2. Do not dominate the online discussion, but give other students a chance to speak to enhance the learning experience.

C) Student Responsibilities

1. Updating Personal Information
   a. Before the beginning of each semester, confirm and update your personal information on MyFCU, including your cell phone and mailing address, so that teachers and staff can contact you. b. Ensure that the o365 email and NID of Feng Chia University are activated.
   b. Ensure that Feng Chia University's o365 email and NID are activated. o365 is the main communication tool for teachers and students.
   c. When communicating with faculty and students, write clearly, politely, and sign your name; anonymous letters will not be answered.

2. Course Outline and Learning Management
   a. Read the course syllabus in detail, understand and comply with the requirements, update the latest information in a timely manner, and reasonably arrange the study time.
   b. Check Feng Chia University's e-mail and iLearn regularly to keep abreast of course information.

3. Teaching Feedback
   a. Fill out the midterm and final teaching feedback forms according to the content and mode of instruction. The midterm evaluation form should be filled out between the 4th and 8th week, and the final survey and the survey on the achievement of learning goals should be filled out before the end of the semester.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
• 誠信的核心價值： 誠信代表著基本的態度與專業價值，並將學術理想具體化為行為原則及社會責任的實踐。學術誠信的關鍵在於思想自由的流通與對他人智慧財產權的尊重之間的平衡。
  • 學生的責任： 學生應重視並遵守智慧財產權的相關規定。在學術活動中，不得提供、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、版權教材和影音資料時應遵循規範。學生需恪守誠信，積極參與課堂學習並尊重每位同學，行事應以負責任和禮貌的態度為準則。
  • 防範學術不誠實行為：
    • 不作弊：在紙筆測驗中，不得交談、窺視他人試卷或故意協助他人，亦不得攜帶、抄襲或傳遞資料。一經發現，違規者該次考試成績將記零分，並依逢甲大學相關規定處理。
    • 不抄襲：提交的作品必須為原創，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲行為。
    • 不偽造：不得篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
    • 不篡改/不捏造：在實驗中應真實記錄數據，不得人為創建或編造不存在的數據或資料來源。
    • 不破壞：不得破壞他人的藝術品、實驗成果或設計作品，未能為團隊專題貢獻也視為學術破壞。
    違規情節將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定處理。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• Core Values of Integrity: Integrity represents fundamental attitudes and professional values that crystallize academic ideals into principles of conduct and socially responsible practices. The key to academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
  • Students are expected to emphasize the importance of and respect for intellectual property rights. Do not offer, use, or accept unauthorized assistance in academic activities. Students are expected to follow the guidelines for the use of library collections, copyrighted materials, and audio-visual materials. Students are expected to act in good faith, to participate actively in class, to treat each student with respect, and to conduct themselves in a responsible and courteous manner.
  • Prevent academic dishonesty:
  1. Do not cheat: Do not talk to, peer at, or intentionally assist others on paper and pencil tests; do not carry, copy, or pass on information. Once found, the offender will receive a zero for the test and will be subject to the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University.
  2. No plagiarism: The work submitted must be original, and any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  3. No forgery: No tampering with grades or other official documents, such as clinic medical certificates.
  4. No tampering/fabrication: Data should be recorded truthfully in the experiment and not artificially created or fabricated from non-existent data or sources.
  5. Non-destruction: Do not destroy other people's artwork, experimental results, or design work. Failure to contribute to the team project will be considered academic sabotage.
  6. Violations will be handled in accordance with the Feng Chia University Student Scholarship and Punishment Program.

   b. 確保逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID啟用，o365為師生溝通的主要工具。
   c. 與教師及同學交流時，務必清晰、禮貌地寫作，並署名，匿名信件不會獲得回覆。

2. 課程大綱與學習管理
   a. 詳讀課程教學大綱，了解並遵守要求，及時更新最新資訊，合理安排學習時間。
   b. 定期檢查逢甲大學電子郵件和iLearn，及時掌握課程信息。

3. 教學回饋
   a. 根據授課內容和方式，填寫期中及期末教學回饋表。期中評估表應於第4至第8週填寫，期末意見調查及學習目標達成情況調查應於學期結束前填寫。
policy.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should be professional, well-prepared and courteous at all times. To ensure a positive learning environment, all students and teachers are expected to respect each other's dignity, which in turn promotes effective learning.
Please observe the following rules as appropriate to the classroom culture.

A) Classroom Etiquette

1. Diversity and Inclusion
   Classroom activities should be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere that respects and appreciates the backgrounds and perspectives of all students, including academic systems, pathways, cultures, races, and genders.

2. Classroom Behavior
   1. Students are expected to be on time for class; if they are unable to arrive on time, they should reconsider their choice of program. 
   2. Avoid talking, reading other materials, dozing, or engaging in non-course related activities during class, and minimize conversations with others unless participating in group discussions. 
   3. listen attentively to classmates when they are giving presentations or asking questions.

B) Course Communication and Internet Etiquette

1. iLearn Classroom Rules
   On the iLearn platform, you must abide by the rules of classroom behavior and respect your classmates and teachers.
   
2. Online Participation
   1. Actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete the learning tasks on time. 
   2. Do not dominate the online discussion, but give other students a chance to speak to enhance the learning experience.

C) Student Responsibilities

1. Updating Personal Information
   a. Before the beginning of each semester, confirm and update your personal information on MyFCU, including your cell phone and mailing address, so that teachers and staff can contact you. b. Ensure that the o365 email and NID of Feng Chia University are activated.
   b. Ensure that Feng Chia University's o365 email and NID are activated. o365 is the main communication tool for teachers and students.
   c. When communicating with faculty and students, write clearly, politely, and sign your name; anonymous letters will not be answered.

2. Course Outline and Learning Management
   a. Read the course syllabus in detail, understand and comply with the requirements, update the latest information in a timely manner, and reasonably arrange the study time.
   b. Check Feng Chia University's e-mail and iLearn regularly to keep abreast of course information.

3. Teaching Feedback
   a. Fill out the midterm and final teaching feedback forms according to the content and mode of instruction. The midterm evaluation form should be filled out between the 4th and 8th week, and the final survey and the survey on the achievement of learning goals should be filled out before the end of the semester.

policy.ais_meno:
• 誠信的核心價值： 誠信代表著基本的態度與專業價值，並將學術理想具體化為行為原則及社會責任的實踐。學術誠信的關鍵在於思想自由的流通與對他人智慧財產權的尊重之間的平衡。
  • 學生的責任： 學生應重視並遵守智慧財產權的相關規定。在學術活動中，不得提供、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、版權教材和影音資料時應遵循規範。學生需恪守誠信，積極參與課堂學習並尊重每位同學，行事應以負責任和禮貌的態度為準則。
  • 防範學術不誠實行為：
    • 不作弊：在紙筆測驗中，不得交談、窺視他人試卷或故意協助他人，亦不得攜帶、抄襲或傳遞資料。一經發現，違規者該次考試成績將記零分，並依逢甲大學相關規定處理。
    • 不抄襲：提交的作品必須為原創，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲行為。
    • 不偽造：不得篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
    • 不篡改/不捏造：在實驗中應真實記錄數據，不得人為創建或編造不存在的數據或資料來源。
    • 不破壞：不得破壞他人的藝術品、實驗成果或設計作品，未能為團隊專題貢獻也視為學術破壞。
    違規情節將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定處理。
policy.ais_meno_en:
• Core Values of Integrity: Integrity represents fundamental attitudes and professional values that crystallize academic ideals into principles of conduct and socially responsible practices. The key to academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
  • Students are expected to emphasize the importance of and respect for intellectual property rights. Do not offer, use, or accept unauthorized assistance in academic activities. Students are expected to follow the guidelines for the use of library collections, copyrighted materials, and audio-visual materials. Students are expected to act in good faith, to participate actively in class, to treat each student with respect, and to conduct themselves in a responsible and courteous manner.
  • Prevent academic dishonesty:
  1. Do not cheat: Do not talk to, peer at, or intentionally assist others on paper and pencil tests; do not carry, copy, or pass on information. Once found, the offender will receive a zero for the test and will be subject to the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University.
  2. No plagiarism: The work submitted must be original, and any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  3. No forgery: No tampering with grades or other official documents, such as clinic medical certificates.
  4. No tampering/fabrication: Data should be recorded truthfully in the experiment and not artificially created or fabricated from non-existent data or sources.
  5. Non-destruction: Do not destroy other people's artwork, experimental results, or design work. Failure to contribute to the team project will be considered academic sabotage.
  6. Violations will be handled in accordance with the Feng Chia University Student Scholarship and Punishment Program.
